description: National Australian self-storage market snapshot: per-size-bracket price quartiles (IQR) and a provider league table with median prices and facility counts. Chart-ready. Rows below the implausibly-cheap floor are excluded from the rows and the market population. A row is below it when its advertised rate is under $5, or when its ongoing rate (the advertised rate if none is known) is under $7 per square metre of unit area, capped at the per-size floor (locker $20, small $20, medium $30, large $50, extra_large $80, garage_plus $50, vehicle $30). A row with no recorded area is held to the per-size floor. Rows with no recorded size and only a category name (large warehouse, office, other, small warehouse, warehouse) are left out too: their prices are unreliable.
name: market_overview
